title: Remote CI wait ends the turn; GitHub polling loops are refused
verification: A remote yoke watch pytest dispatch prints that its CI wait is recorded and the verdict wakes the session with the continue command. The polling lint refuses until/while loops that sleep between GitHub CLI run reads, with no override. With a work claim held, the Stop promised-work gate lets that turn end while the session has an unnotified recorded CI wait of any kind, and holds it again once the wait is notified. Source tests cover each; no live headless wake proof is claimed. Candidate source tests preserve explicit cancellation, prevent its automatic QA redispatch, drop older pending candidate waits within the session/repository/gate kind, and direct cancelled notices to current candidate evidence.
